messages:
maria_p: Quick sync — sales asked for an "escape hatch" for large customers who hit commit ceilings. They want auto-rollover months and a temporary burst lane. Thoughts?
ezra: Can we separate "billing escape hatch" from traffic QoS? We should avoid coupling SLOs to billing tricks.
linh: +1. Operationally we can offer a 30d roll-forward for unused commit credits (contract term opt-in) and a one-off paid burst pack (X tokens) for emergencies.
samir_pm: What's the product tradeoff if we enable roll-forward? Revenue recognition + accounting complexity, and it reduces urgency for upsell.
jen_ops: From ops side, burst packs should be capped per-tenant and routed to a lower-priority capacity pool. Need a policy: bursts cost 2x normal rate and require billing approval.
maria_p: Sales pushing for automatic rollovers (no approval) to lower legal friction. Legal flagged long retention of rollover balances as a liability.
linh: Proposal: 30d automatic rollover up to 20% of commit, then require manual approval for more. Burst packs disabled for accounts on trial or with outstanding invoices.
ezra: Also need a clear telemetry trigger for when to move customers to Dedicated/Private rather than sell bursts — e.g., sustained 3x baseline for 7 days.
samir_pm: Launch criteria: product + billing + legal sign-off, console UI for credits, backend APIs, migration guide for customers, and automated telemetry alerts. Agree?
jen_ops: I can own billing rate changes and capacity routing. Need docs for SRE runbook: how to throttle, how to escalate customers to Sales ops.
maria_p: Action items: Samir to draft spec for roll-forward + burst pack and migration triggers, Linh to draft ops routing policy, Jen to draft billing/rate rules, Ezra to add telemetry SLO triggers. Check back EOD Friday. :thumbsup:
billing_bot: Invoice alert: draft pricing change will require product-led discount table update (ticket #PL-469).
